Back in April, OpenAI launched an upgraded version of its image generation technology, called ChatGPT Images 2. Five months later, the company is now releasing an enhanced version, ChatGPT Images 2.5.

Compared with the company's previous image generation tools, ChatGPT Images 2 represents a major leap forward.

It introduced 2K resolution output, support for multiple aspect ratios, and the ability to pull in the latest information via web search. Images 2 also strengthened handling of non-Latin language systems, and offered two intelligence levels: Instant and Thinking.

The new Images 2.5 version focuses on "clearer details, faster generation, more precise editing, and improved tools for creating and sharing".

OpenAI said: "Images 2.5 delivers more natural lighting, richer textures, higher fidelity to subjects in reference images, and more reliable adherence to editing instructions across multiple rounds of conversation."

"Compared with Images 2.0, we have also reduced image generation latency by up to 50%, so you can generate images and refine ideas more quickly."

In addition, the company detailed a brand-new "Sketch" feature that lets users draw directly inside ChatGPT and use those drawings as references for image generation. OpenAI is also rolling out templates for popular image formats, a prompt-sharing feature that lets others try out your image generation ideas, and other new capabilities.

Separately, OpenAI is offering developers two versions of Images 2.5 to help them integrate the capabilities into their applications. GPT-Image-2.5 Flare and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst will be made available via OpenAI's API:

GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare brings the same improvements in quality, editing, and speed to the API. It is the recommended choice for most applications, delivering image quality higher than GPT‑Image‑2 with 50% lower latency. It suits a wide range of use cases, from creator and social media content, product experiences, and visual search, to rapid image prototyping and large-scale generation. GPT‑Image‑2.5 Sunburst is designed for advanced visual workflows that require more precise editing control, and is well suited to creative and editing workflows such as producing advertising assets or polished product images.

OpenAI said: "Images 2.5 will begin rolling out from today across desktop, mobile, and web for all tiers of ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users." To learn more about the new image generation technology, visit here.

The launch of ChatGPT Images 2.5 follows last week's release of GPT-6 Astra.
